post.description: Generate a sticker image from text prompt with optional image context

grid.description: Request grid sheet output; when true you must send layout (e.g. 4x4) or both rows and cols

layout.description: Grid dimensions like 4x4 (alternative to rows + cols when grid is true)

rows.description: Grid row count when grid is true (use with cols)

cols.description: Grid column count when grid is true (use with rows)

normalize.description: When grid is true, optionally normalize the sheet before splitting (same as /grid/split)

post.description: Splits a sticker grid sheet into per-cell PNGs. Grid lines are detected with image heuristics, optionally combined with AI. When both `rows` and `cols` are sent, boundary detection is aligned to that row×column lattice. When `normalize` is true, the sheet is LLM-normalized and re-detected when possible; on failure the API falls back to splitting the original image. Each cell is optionally analyzed for caption-style text outside the sticker foreground, passed through background removal, then resized to a square 512×512 contain fit.

image.description: Grid sheet image (PNG, JPEG, or WebP)

rows.description: Optional row count. Use together with `cols` so split boundaries follow a fixed rows×cols lattice (same lattice behavior as `generate` with `grid=true`).

cols.description: Optional column count. Must be sent with `rows` for lattice-aligned splitting.

normalize.description: When true, normalize the sheet via AI before re-detecting boundaries and splitting. In multipart forms you may also send the string "true". If normalization fails, splitting still proceeds on the original image.

200.description: Successfully split grid; each item in `data.images` may include `textOutsideForeground` when caption-like text outside the subject was detected for that cell. See `data.metadata` for layout and normalization URLs.

post.summary: Extract text assets from grid cells
post.description: Accepts multiple grid cell images and extracts caption-like text outside the foreground subject for each image using LLM analysis. Returns text assets and metadata in the same metadata shape used by grid split endpoints.

images.description: One or more cell images (PNG, JPEG, JPG, WebP, or GIF)

200.description: Successfully extracted text assets for each provided cell image.

post.description: Remove background from a raster image. Static inputs (PNG, JPEG, WebP, single-frame GIF) return a 512×512 PNG with transparent letterboxing. Animated GIFs (multiple frames) return an animated GIF re-encoded after per-frame segmentation; GIF transparency uses a palette so edges may differ from PNG. Tuning env vars include `ANIMATED_GIF_DITHER`, `ANIMATED_GIF_ALPHA_BOOST_DIVISOR`, `ANIMATED_GIF_ALPHA_CLOSE_KERNEL`, `ANIMATED_GIF_CORNER_BG_STRIP_DIST`, `ANIMATED_GIF_TEMPORAL_ALPHA_MAX_HALF` (rolling max ±neighbours in time), `ANIMATED_GIF_TEMPORAL_ALPHA_PASSES`, `ANIMATED_GIF_TEMPORAL_DILATE_ALPHA` (post-merge alpha dilate), `ANIMATED_GIF_REUSE_PALETTE=true` (smaller files), plus frame limits (`ANIMATED_GIF_MAX_FRAMES`, default 120; `ANIMATED_GIF_MAX_MEGAPIXELS_PER_FRAME`, default 12 MP). If those temporal and alpha vars are unset, defaults lean toward fuller, time-stable sticker edges (temporal half 3, 3 passes, dilate kernel 5, alpha boost divisor ~0.76—raise dilate/halos sparingly if fringes appear). Response `metadata.outputFormat` is `gif` or `png`; animated responses include `metadata.frameCount`.

image.description: Image to remove background from (PNG, JPG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF including animated GIF)

action.description: Use delete to remove sticker pack or sticker; omit or set upload for normal file upload

images.description: Sticker images to upload (up to 30). Required only when action=upload

stickerPackId.description: Existing sticker pack ID to add stickers to, or required for action=delete

stickerPackName.description: Name for new sticker pack (if stickerPackId not provided)

existingStickerIds.description: JSON array of existing sticker IDs to add to pack

stickerId.description: When action=delete: if provided with stickerPackId, delete this sticker from pack and soft-delete sticker

get.description: Get incremental changes since last sync for offline-first support. Soft-deleted sticker packs and stickers are returned in deleted arrays.

parameters.name: lastSyncAt
parameters.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last sync. Omit for full sync.

maxUses.description: Maximum number of uses for this link

textOutsideForeground.description: Only on grid-derived cells when analysis detected caption-style text outside the sticker foreground

TextStyleMetadata.description: Optional caption typography inferred when text sits outside the sticker foreground

TextOutsideForeground.description: Merged caption-style text outside the sticker subject for one cell image

cellCount.description: Number of cells produced (matches length of `data.images`)

normalizedImageUrl.description: Public URL of the AI-normalized full sheet when `normalize` succeeded

outputSize.description: Final square contain size for each cell image

normalized.description: Whether normalization was requested and a normalized sheet URL was stored

backgroundRemoved.description: Whether background removal succeeded for at least one cell

backgroundRemovalMethod.description: Which removal pipeline(s) ran post-split, e.g. `post-split:rembg|sharp`

textOutsideForeground.description: Present when caption-like text outside the sticker foreground was detected
